name: NAAW Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The promotion's top championship, defended at every supercard and roughly every three to four weeks otherwise.

name: NAAW American Championship
epitaph: The promotion's secondary title, contested weekly.

name: NAAW Lightheavyweight Championship
epitaph: The promotion's weight-limited title, its lineage disputed on-air by two rival challengers in mid-1999.
